mapper.select: SELECT seed_pack AS "seedPack", version, checksum_sha256 AS "checksumSha256", import_mode AS "importMode", imported_at AS "importedAt" FROM seed_import_history WHERE seed_pack = #{seedPack} AND version = #{version}

SELECT seed_pack AS "seedPack", version, checksum_sha256 AS "checksumSha256", import_mode AS "importMode", imported_at AS "importedAt" FROM seed_import_history WHERE seed_pack = #{seedPack} ORDER BY imported_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM topic WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT id FROM category WHERE code = #{code}
INSERT INTO category (code, name, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, 0, 'ENABLED') ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

INSERT INTO topic (category_id, code, external_key, name, star_level, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{code}, #{code}, #{name}, #{starLevel}, 0, 'ENABLED') ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET category_id = EXCLUDED.category_id, external_key = COALESCE(topic.external_key, EXCLUDED.external_key), name = EXCLUDED.name, star_level = EXCLUDED.star_level, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

INSERT INTO question ( topic_id, external_key, title, question_type, star_level, difficulty, frequency_level, origin_type, status, one_liner, plain_explanation, design_reason, common_mistakes, score_points, seed_pack, source_version ) VALUES ( #{topicId}, #{question.externalKey}, #{question.title}, #{question.questionType}, #{question.starLevel}, #{question.difficulty}, #{question.frequencyLevel}, #{question.originType}, #{question.status}, #{question.oneLiner}, #{question.plainExplanation}, #{question.designReason}, #{question.commonMistakes}, #{question.scorePoints}, #{seedPack}, #{question.sourceVersion} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET topic_id = #{topicId}, title = #{question.title}, question_type = #{question.questionType}, star_level = #{question.starLevel}, difficulty = #{question.difficulty}, frequency_level = #{question.frequencyLevel}, status = #{question.status}, one_liner = #{question.oneLiner}, plain_explanation = #{question.plainExplanation}, design_reason = #{question.designReason}, common_mistakes = #{question.commonMistakes}, score_points = #{question.scorePoints}, seed_pack = #{seedPack}, source_version = #{question.sourceVersion}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE external_key = #{question.externalKey} AND ( origin_type = 'BUILTIN' OR (origin_type = 'IMPORTED' AND seed_pack = #{seedPack}) )
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tag (code, name) VALUES (#{code}, #{code}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_answer (question_id, answer_type, content, sort_order) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{answerType}, #{content}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO question_follow_up (question_id, title, reference_answer, sort_order) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{title}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{sortOrder})

INSERT INTO seed_import (seed_pack, version, imported_at) VALUES (#{seedPack}, #{version}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (seed_pack) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version, imported_at = EXCLUDED.imported_at
